selected_experts.reason: Verify the fish's identity as a tench (Tinca tinca) by checking for key taxonomic features: small deeply embedded cycloid scales, olive-green to golden-bronze coloration, small head with blunt downturned mouth, two short barbels at each corner, small eyes with reddish-orange iris, short rounded dorsal fin, truncate caudal fin, and complete lateral line.
Locate the tench in the image to identify specific body parts (head, mouth, barbels, eyes, dorsal fin, caudal fin, lateral line) for detailed anatomical verification.
Check the fish's body boundaries for continuity, ensuring no floating parts or blurred edges, and verify the distinct separation between the fish and the background (water/vegetation).
Assess the overall image quality, focusing on the texture of the fish's skin (mucous-coated appearance) and the clarity of its scales and fins.
Verify the spatial relationship between the man and the fish, ensuring the fish is physically held and not fused with the man's hands or background.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay special attention to the presence of two short barbels at each corner of the mouth, the small reddish-orange eyes, the short rounded dorsal fin, and the complete lateral line.
